subject: Urgent: Conversation stream slowdown — customer impact & next steps
messages:
From: Ishaan Rao <ishaan.rao@novustech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Thomas <mthomas@novustech.com>, support@novustech.com
Date: 2025-04-11T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Realtime chat responses slowing across user sessions

Hi Stephanie,

We're seeing a significant slowdown on the streaming/chat endpoint for interactive sessions across multiple users since ~07:40 PDT. Messages are still delivered, but tokens arrive in big bursts (20–30s gaps) making the UI stutter badly. Impact: 60% of active sessions show degraded UX, and one of our voice agents dropped mid-conversation.

Quick sample from our client logs: 
- request_id: 0a3f7c9b
- start: 2025-04-11T07:39:58Z
- first_token_delay: 2200ms
- token_emission_pattern: [fast, fast, gap 23s, fast]

We already tried switching to a smaller model instance (non-streaming) which reduces latency but breaks our live streaming UX. Can you confirm if this is on Redwood's side? We need immediate mitigation guidance — any short-term toggles we can use?

Attaching the trace export and a short capture.

Thanks,
Ishaan Rao
Engineering Lead, Conversational AI
NovusTech

Attachment: incident_trace_20250411.ndjson (trace export)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ishaan Rao <ishaan.rao@novustech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-04-11T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime chat responses slowing across user sessions

Hi Ishaan — thanks for flagging this and for the trace. We see the pattern in our telemetry (intermittent token-emission gaps on a subset of edge shards). We're treating this as high priority.

Short-term mitigations you can test now (low friction, non-code):
- Fall back to the non-streaming /generate endpoint for mission-critical flows (reduces UX fidelity, restores predictable latency).
- Reduce max_tokens_per_call by 30% for long-context sessions to reduce KV-cache growth.
- If you can, set a client-side streaming timeout of 10s and auto-retry once; this avoids long blackouts and keeps sessions responsive.

We'll apply a temporary server-side pacing fix (see temporary-config.patch attached) to limit KV cache growth on affected shards — this should reduce burst gaps within ~60–90 minutes. Monica, Ben: can you own the patch rollout + customer verification?

Ishaan — I'll keep you updated at 9:30 and then hourly until resolved.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0198

Attachment: temporary-config.patch (diff, 4KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-04-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime chat responses slowing across user sessions

On Fri, Apr 11, 2025 at 8:40 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Ishaan — thanks for flagging this and for the trace. We see the pattern in our telemetry...

Laura — ops runbook: we suspect KV-cache growth from large-context interactive sessions is causing occasional GC/eviction pressure on westus-edge-3 (affects ~12% of live streaming capacity). Plan:
1) Apply temporary-config.patch to cap per-session KV cache at 30MB (rollout to westus-edge-3 only).
2) Enable an aggressive prefix-cache TTL for 90 minutes to allow shards to shed memory.
3) Monitor token emission 1m/5m windows; if gaps persist, enable a live fallback route to dedicated non-streaming nodes for affected tenant (NovusTech).

I'll coordinate with Laura for the patch and then ping Ishaan for verification. Ben — can you prepare a quick note for NovusTech billing team in case we need to offer a goodwill credit?

–Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ishaan Rao <ishaan.rao@novustech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-04-11T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Realtime chat responses slowing across user sessions — update and postmortem link

Hi all — update from ops after the rollout and verification: 
- Root cause: a memory-pressure cascade on westus-edge-3 triggered by long-context streams combined with a recent model change that increased per-token KV size. When KV exceeded a threshold some shards entered a backpressure state that deferred token emission until a background eviction cycle, producing 15–30s gaps.
- Mitigation performed: rolled temporary-config.patch to cap per-session KV at 30MB (applied 09:25 PDT), enabled aggressive prefix-cache TTLs, and routed ~8% of NovusTech traffic to non-streaming dedicated nodes for 2h as a warm fallback while shards recovered.
- Customer impact window: 2025-04-11T07:39:58Z to 2025-04-11T10:05:00Z (approx).

We've produced a short postmortem and a longer runbook for engineering teams to avoid repeat occurrences. Link: https://redwood-drive.company.com/shared/NovusTech/2025-04-11-incident-runbook (public to NovusTech link). The postmortem PDF is attached.

Next steps (action owners):
- Infra/Runtime (Laura): push permanent guarding for KV growth and add a telemetry alarm (done: SR-11032).
- Product (Monica/Stephanie): share recommended client-side config (max_tokens, streaming-timeout) by 2025-04-13.
- Account (Ben): propose a goodwill credit; coordinate with customer finance.

Ishaan — we sincerely apologize for the disruption. We'll set up a 30-min follow-up tomorrow to walk through the postmortem and the recommended config changes; please let us know a window that works.

Thanks for your patience.
Laura Bennett
Site Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: postmortem-20250411.pdf (summary, 2 pages)
